prompts.background: Use case: illustration-story. Production environment BACKGROUND LAYER for an animated title screen of original anime adventure game SOULMONSTERS: ELO DAS RUINAS. Landscape wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos. Ancient abandoned stone gateway deep in a Brazilian tropical forest at blue hour, enormous weathered pillars and fractured arch in the RIGHT HALF, broad worn stone steps running gently from lower center into a huge deep pitch-dark recess on the right. The ancient gateway architecture is fictional and original, no real-world religious or Indigenous symbols. Subtle carved diamond/kite structural motifs, aged warm limestone, roots gripping stone, sparse broad tropical foliage and tiny ferns. Sparse muted terracotta remnants of old kite banners hanging from masonry, not waving all over. Atmospheric pale teal night haze in the distant gateway, a narrow beam of warm dawn light grazing one high broken arch edge, rich dark ink blue-green shadows and restrained ivory/gold stone edges. LEFT HALF, especially upper left through center, is a calm, deep blue-green shadowy expanse with simple distant forest and only very low-contrast forms, deliberately reserved for large readable game logo added in code. Bottom central region stays calm and dark for a PRESS START control added in code. Moody, sacred, inviting mystery, magical wind and forgotten bonds. Japanese 2D TV-adventure anime background painting with clean hand-painted stone planes and restrained painterly foliage, coherent simple animation game art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D render, NOT pixel art, no excessive microtexture. Layer purpose: static depth scene only, NO monster, NO people, no floating sparks, no foreground opaque fog bands (these will be animated separately), no UI, no lettering, no watermark. Strong environmental composition with clear empty space left and dark gateway right; do not put a central monument over reserved left logo area. Entire image landscape background, opaque.
prompts.presence: Use case: identity-preserve / lighting-weather. Using the attached Eremor character concept as exact identity, create the isolated ANIMATED TITLE-SCREEN PRESENCE LAYER for Soulmonsters: Elo das Ruinas. Preserve the exact ancestral ground sloth creature design, massive body, 3 hooked claws per forepaw, five enormous connected ivory kite sails with terracotta geometric markings and bamboo spars over shoulders, big terracotta interlaced bond knot on sternum, short sloth muzzle, two broad connected tail ribbons. Do NOT redesign the species, do not add horns, wings, more limbs, jewelry or face markings. Same general full-body three-quarter pose, but solemn and still, head slightly lowered as if dormant. Change LIGHTING and SIMPLIFICATION: almost the entire beast is deep blue-green/navy shadow, 85-90% of its surface visually concealed. Only a fine muted ivory-teal rim catches the top sail silhouette and some upper claw edges; at the chest knot, a tiny restrained warm turquoise seam is visible. One tiny dim turquoise eye in shadow. Body markings barely readable, not brightly colored. This should be the implied presence of an ancient legendary behind fog in the dark gateway, not a fully revealed character showcase. Clear strong silhouette, no internal faceted texture noise, clean 2D anime cel rendering. NO glow halo behind the beast, NO fog or smoke baked in, NO light rays behind, NO background or ground or ruins. Genuine transparent alpha background. Landscape full-body isolate, large 10% transparent margins all around, every claw and connected tail tip fully inside frame, monster fills only 80% canvas. No logo, labels or text. Output ONLY the dark creature layer; environment and fog will be separate real-time layers.
